verdict.rationale: Circle documents registrable outbound webhooks: it sends an HTTP POST to your configured endpoint when a resource changes state, and it offers webhook subscription management for Gateway events. CPN notifications are signed and verifiable via a public-key endpoint, so a system can track money-movement state without polling. Missing for 10: the specific event types (payment confirmed, payout settled, conversion executed) are not enumerated, signature verification is evidenced only for CPN rather than across all products, StableFX conversion webhooks are not shown, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration.
